During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] initiated a '''blockade''' of the [[Falleen system/Legends|Falleen system]].<ref name="TToCM">{{WEGCite|story=The Treasure of Celis Mott|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref><ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> To curb Falleen influence in the galaxy and safeguard the Empire's interests on their world, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Eisen Kerioth]] of the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]] enforced this [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. The [[King/Legends|kings]] of Falleen expressed that the Empire had gone too far.<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref> [[Xishel]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], evaded the blockaded to begin his life of crime.<ref name="TToCM" />
